units.source_text: 此诗并不特别优越，只是回思今昔世态之变迁，率尔述怀而已。

en.t: This poem is not especially outstanding; it merely looks back on how the ways of the world have changed from past to present, and gives a spontaneous account of my feelings.

units.source_text: 遂命赐使者酒食，犒赏丰厚无比。

en.t: He then ordered that the envoy be given wine and food, and rewarded him with unmatched generosity.
